  "source": [
    "FUNCTION trint_tadir_delete.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"Lokale Schnittstelle:",
    "*\"       IMPORTING",
    "*\"             VALUE(OBJECT) LIKE  TADIR-OBJECT",
    "*\"             VALUE(OBJ_NAME) LIKE  TADIR-OBJ_NAME",
    "*\"             VALUE(PGMID) LIKE  TADIR-PGMID",
    "*\"             VALUE(IV_TEST_MODE) LIKE  TRPARI-FLAG DEFAULT ' '",
    "*\"       EXCEPTIONS",
    "*\"              TADIR_ENTRY_NOT_EXISTING",
    "*\"              OBJECT_EXISTS",
    "*\"              OBJECT_LOCKED",
    "*\"              OBJECT_DISTRIBUTED",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "  DATA: lv_object_exists   LIKE trpari-s_exists,",
    "        ls_tadir_old       LIKE tadir,",
    "        ls_tadir_new       LIKE tadir,",
    "        lv_locked          LIKE trpari-s_checked,",
    "        lv_lock_task       LIKE e070-trkorr,",
    "        ls_e071            LIKE e071.",
    "",
    "",
    "  ls_e071-pgmid     =    pgmid.",
    "  ls_e071-object    =    object.",
    "  ls_e071-obj_name  =    obj_name.",
    "",
    "*** check if TADIR exists **********************************************",
    "  SELECT SINGLE * FROM tadir INTO ls_tadir_old",
    "                             WHERE    pgmid    = pgmid",
    "                             AND      object   = object",
    "                             AND      obj_name = obj_name.",
    "  IF   sy-subrc >< 0.",
    "    MESSAGE  e027(tr)",
    "             WITH      pgmid object obj_name",
    "             RAISING   tadir_entry_not_existing.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*** delete only if object realy doesn't exist **************************",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'CHECK_EXIST'",
    "       EXPORTING",
    "            iv_pgmid             = ls_tadir_old-pgmid",
    "            iv_object            = ls_tadir_old-object",
    "            iv_obj_name          = ls_tadir_old-obj_name",
    "       IMPORTING",
    "            e_exist              = lv_object_exists",
    "       EXCEPTIONS",
    "            tr_no_check_function = 01.",
    "  IF  sy-subrc         =  0",
    "  and lv_object_exists CA 'XN?'.",
    "    MESSAGE  e033(tr)",
    "             WITH      pgmid object obj_name",
    "             RAISING   object_exists.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "**delete only if object  is unlocked **********************************",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'TR_CHECK_OBJECT_LOCK'",
    "       EXPORTING",
    "            wi_object    = ls_e071-object",
    "            wi_objname   = ls_e071-obj_name",
    "            wi_pgmid     = ls_e071-pgmid",
    "       IMPORTING",
    "            we_locked    = lv_locked",
    "            we_lock_task = lv_lock_task",
    "       EXCEPTIONS",
    "            OTHERS       = 01.",
    "  IF   sy-subrc            ><   0.",
    "    MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE sy-msgty NUMBER sy-msgno",
    "            WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4",
    "    RAISING object_locked.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF   lv_locked           ><   space.",
    "    MESSAGE e022(tr) WITH pgmid object obj_name lv_lock_task",
    "                     RAISING object_locked.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "***delete of original-entries only when not distributed ****************",
    "  IF ls_tadir_old-srcsystem = sy-sysid.",
    "    IF ls_tadir_old-cproject+1(1) CA ' S'.",
    "      MESSAGE e024(tr) WITH pgmid object obj_name",
    "                       RAISING object_distributed.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "******exit for check_mode                                        *******",
    "  IF iv_test_mode >< space.",
    "    EXIT.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "***  delete GTADIR only original in transportable dev.classes **********",
    "*    status = 0.",
    "*    if   ls_tadir_old-srcsystem   =    sy-sysid",
    "*    and  ls_tadir_old-devclass(1) na   '$T'.",
    "*         move-corresponding ls_tadir_old to ls_gtadir.",
    "*         call function 'TR_GTADIR_REMOVE'",
    "*              exporting  tab_in                = ls_gtadir",
    "*              exceptions communication_failure = 1",
    "*                        system_failure        = 2",
    "*                         tr_object_exists      = 3",
    "*                         tr_distributed        = 4.",
    "*",
    "*** in case of communication errors, fill table ttadir *****************",
    "*         status         =    sy-subrc.",
    "*         if   status    =    1",
    "*         or   status    =    2.",
    "*              ls_tadir_old-cproject+3(1) = 'L'.",
    "*         endif.",
    "*    endif.",
    "",
    "*** delete TADIR-entry on database *************************************",
    "  DELETE tadir FROM ls_tadir_old.",
    "*   delete from tadir where pgmid    = ls_tadir_old-pgmid",
    "*                     and   object   = ls_tadir_old-object",
    "*                     and   obj_name = ls_tadir_old-obj_name.",
    "  IF   sy-subrc >< 0.",
    "    MESSAGE  e757(tk)",
    "             WITH      pgmid object obj_name",
    "             RAISING   tadir_entry_not_existing.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "",
    "*** update workbench index *********************************************",
    "  CALL FUNCTION 'RS_MODIFY_OBJECT_PROPERTIES'",
    "       EXPORTING",
    "            new_adir  = ls_tadir_new",
    "            old_adir  = ls_tadir_old",
    "            operation = 'DELETE'.",
    "",
    "*** in case of communication errors, fill table ttadir *****************",
    "*    if   status    =    1",
    "*    or   status    =    2.",
    "*        call function 'TR_MODIFY_TTADIR'",
    "*              exporting wi_tadir   = ls_tadir_old",
    "*                       command    = 'D'.",
    "*   endif.",
    "ENDFUNCTION."
  ],
